title: Interpretation: Required inspections for gantry cranes

excerpt: 'Oregon OSHA does not require that crane inspections be performed by outside inspectors.'
limitations: Oregon state plan, not federal OSHA; Illinois private employers fall under federal OSHA, but the federal text (1910.179(j)) it interprets is identical.

title: Standard interpretation: complete/periodic inspection under 1910.179(j)(3)

excerpt: Paraphrase: interpretation covers only 29 CFR 1910.179 and is not intended to interpret ANSI/ASME standards.
limitations: Does not address who may inspect.
